Chocolate Ice Cream Roll

.cook
📖 Grandma Schwennesen

🥘 Ingredients

  • baking powder
    1 tsp
  • cocoa
    0.33 cup
  • confectioner's sugar
  • eggs
    4
  • flour
    1/2 cup
  • hot fudge
  • salt
    1/4 tsp
  • softened ice cream
  • sugar
    3/4 cup
  • whipped cream

🍳 Cookware

  • large bowl
  • baking pan
  • large bowl
  1. 1
    Separate eggs ; put whites in a large bowl . Let stand at room temperature for ⏱️ 30 minutes . Line a greased 15x10 inch baking pan with waxed paper; grease the paper and set aside.
    eggs: 4
  2. 2
    In a large bowl , beat egg yolks and sugar on high speed for ⏱️ 5 minutes or until thick and lemon-colored. Sift the flour , cocoa , baking powder , and salt together; gradually add to the yolk mixture and mix well (batter will be very thick).
    sugar: 1/2 cup, flour: 1/2 cup, cocoa: 0.33 cup, baking powder: 1 tsp, salt: 1/4 tsp
  3. 3
    Beat egg whites on medium speed until soft peaks form. Gradually beat in sugar , 1 tbsp at a time, on high speed until stiff peaks form. Stir the whites into the batter a little at a time. Spread evenly into the prepared pan.
    sugar: 1/4 cup
  4. 4
    Bake at 375 F for ⏱️ 10-12 minutes or until cake springs back when lightly touched. Cool for ⏱️ 5 minutes . Invert the cake onto a kitchen towel dusted with confectioner's sugar . Gently peel off paper. Roll the cake in the towel jelly-roll style, starting with a short side. Cool on a wire rack.
    confectioner's sugar
  5. 5
    Unroll cake and top with softened ice cream . Roll up without towel. Place seam side down on a platter. Cover and freeze for at least ⏱️ 4 hours before slicing. Sprinkle with confectioner's sugar ; serve with hot fudge and whipped cream .
    softened ice cream, confectioner's sugar, hot fudge, whipped cream
